newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bilfinger wins 96 mln dmk rail contract.
newsitem.headline: Bilfinger wins 96 mln dmk rail contract.

text.p: German construction group Bilfinger und Berger Bauaktiengesellshaft on Wednesday said it had won a 96 million mark contract from Deutsche Bahn to build a rail station linking the Frankfurt airport with a new Frankfurt-Cologne rail link.
Bilfinger said the total project was valued at 160 million marks.
The rail station will be located near the airport terminal between two major German motorways.
Construction began this month and is scheduled to be completed by the middle of 1999, Bilfinger said in a statement. Bilfinger
